shots.title: The Monday promise
shots.action: Marcus points firmly at the Monday box on his wall calendar with confident optimism.
shots.props: wall calendar, table, pen
shots.words: Marcus promised he would start on Monday.

shots.title: Fourteen in a row
shots.action: Camera pans across 14 crossed-out Monday squares on the long planner.
shots.props: grid of calendar squares, marker strokes
shots.words: Exactly fourteen Mondays in a row.

shots.title: Thursday gear haul
shots.action: Marcus carries a brand new shoe box and water bottle into the hallway.
shots.props: shoe box, sleek water bottle, entrance mat
shots.words: Every Thursday, he bought new gear.

shots.title: Sunday night alarms
shots.action: Marcus sets three alarm clocks lined up in a row on the side table.
shots.props: three digital alarm clocks, lamp, notebook
shots.words: By Sunday night, he set three alarms

shots.title: Total transformation ready
shots.action: Marcus stands hands on hips, radiating triumphant readiness for tomorrow.
shots.props: neatly folded workout outfit, gym bag
shots.words: for a total life transformation.

shots.title: Monday morning arrives
shots.action: Morning dawns; gloomy grey light fills the room as Marcus stumbles in sleepily.
shots.props: window, grey sky, kitchen counter
shots.words: Then Monday arrived.

shots.title: The spilled coffee
shots.action: A coffee mug knocks over, dark coffee spills across the edge of the daily schedule.
shots.props: tipped ceramic mug, spreading coffee stain, paper
shots.words: A spilled coffee or one grey cloud.

shots.title: The sigh of defeat
shots.action: Marcus drops his shoulders and sighs deeply with theatrical disappointment.
shots.props: stained mug, paper napkin
shots.words: Because the morning wasn't flawless, Marcus sighed

shots.title: Postponed to next week
shots.action: Marcus draws a big red arrow from today's box directly to next Monday.
shots.props: wall calendar, red marker pen
shots.words: and postponed everything to next week.

shots.title: Museum of unopened boxes
shots.action: Marcus squeezes past an impressive tower of unopened cardboard delivery boxes.
shots.props: stacked cardboard parcels, pristine sneaker box, coat rack
shots.words: His hallway became a museum of unopened boxes.

shots.title: Neighbour's cold car
shots.action: Outside on the driveway, the older neighbour sits in an old pickup truck, turning the ignition key.
shots.props: pickup truck, driveway, front porch, fence
shots.words: Luckily, his neighbour was starting a cold car on Tuesday.

shots.title: The unsolicited lecture
shots.action: Marcus approaches the car window, gesturing advice about engine warm-up and ideal atmospheric conditions.
shots.props: car window, neighbour at wheel, jacket
shots.words: Unluckily, Marcus wanted to explain optimal conditions.

shots.title: The engine rolls anyway
shots.action: The truck exhaust puffs a cartoon smoke ring, wheels spin, and the car rolls cheerfully down the lane.
shots.props: puff of exhaust smoke, turning tyres, driveway
shots.words: The engine coughed and rolled into gear anyway.

shots.title: The symbolic milestone
shots.action: Marcus looks closely at the shiny gold-edged Monday marker on his desk.
shots.props: desk, notebook, gold Monday token
shots.words: You see, waiting for a symbolic Monday

shots.title: Polished excuse
shots.action: Marcus looks at his hands, realizing how neat his excuses have been.
shots.props: open planner, pen on table
shots.words: is just a polished excuse to delay effort.

shots.title: The traffic light analogy
shots.action: A stylized street intersection shows three traffic lights in a row at different colors.
shots.props: model street, traffic light post, mini car in driveway
shots.words: You don't wait for every traffic light in town

shots.title: Just start rolling
shots.action: The little car simply pulls forward into the street without hesitating.
shots.props: driveway curb, moving car, street lamp
shots.words: to turn green before leaving your driveway.

shots.title: Thursday arrives
shots.action: Thursday 3 PM: Marcus stands in his ordinary socks in the living room; kettle steams in background.
shots.props: steaming kettle, coffee table, living room rug, ordinary socks
shots.words: So on Thursday, Marcus didn't wait for a clean slate.

shots.title: Dropping to the rug
shots.action: Marcus drops down onto the patterned rug right beside the coffee table.
shots.props: woven rug, coffee table leg, slippers on floor
shots.words: He dropped to his living room rug

shots.title: Ten pushups in socks
shots.action: Marcus powers through pushups, arms flexing, face determined and energized.
shots.props: rug texture, socks, sweat puff
shots.words: and did ten pushups in his socks.

shots.title: Fourteen Mondays zero
shots.action: The big wall calendar with its 14 pristine empty Monday checkmarks.
shots.props: calendar, untouched boxes in corner
shots.words: Fourteen perfect Mondays delivered nothing.

shots.title: One messy Thursday
shots.action: Marcus stands sweaty and smiling, holding a scribbled Thursday workout tally. The spell is broken.
shots.props: scribbled notepad, thumb up, steam from kettle
shots.words: One messy Thursday broke the spell.
